editorial.blurb: A family-owned Uyghur spot with generous portions at budget-friendly prices and a spacious dining room.
editorial.insiderTip: Order a regular plate with your choice of rice, fried rice, or lo mein plus two entrées—you'll get a drink included and portions that won't quit, all for around $11.

topDishes.note: Reviewers praised it as a standout with good flavor
